conflicts.finding: General VAG route catalogue maps steering assist 0x712->0x77C, while the Mii electric OVMS implementation uses 0x712->0x71A. Both routes are kept, scoped to the evidence that produced them (seat_mii_steering_assist_712_71a, seat_vag_steering_assist_712_77c).
conflicts.resolution: Keep both. 0x712->0x71A is exact Mii-electric platform evidence; 0x712->0x77C is a broader VAG/MQB candidate.

conflicts.finding: Current model defaults for Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Alhambra, Altea and Mii Electric are empty while the SEAT make-level fallback and other sources contain useful data.
conflicts.resolution: Empty model repository state is not negative vehicle evidence and must never delete local or make-level knowledge.

conflicts.finding: SEAT make-level OBDb fallback mixes PQ/MQB/electrified commands and contains competing interpretations/formulas for some DIDs.
conflicts.resolution: Store decoder variants keyed by route+platform+ECU fingerprint; no brand-global decoder promotion.

conflicts.finding: Make-level OBDb contains commands with hdr=FC00, rax=FE0077, pri=17, tst=F1 for ATF-temperature variants.
conflicts.resolution: Treat as transport-normalization research only. It does not authorize generic 29-bit enumeration.

conflicts.finding: Ibiza 6J can mix K-line KWP2000, TP2.0, TP1.6 and UDS across ECUs.
conflicts.resolution: UDS silence can mean wrong transport rather than ECU absence.
